issues.what: Keyframe snap of pottery-neolithic-levant at -5500: 13 cells added, 12 removed (Haifa, Jerusalem, HaMerkaz in; Amman and Lebanon out). It is the dossier's own switch from the Yarmukian shape (-6000..-5501) to the Wadi Rabah shape (-5500..-4400), carried by a rename event with no region; the whole state is only about 106 cells. Not a missing event.

Oshara tradition (start -5440) is drawn as the whole of Colorado and New Mexico less a 150 km disc in the south-west (1,878 cells, about 475,000 km2). The dossier's own note says this overstates a tradition known from sites near Denver, the Upper Gunnison, Mesa Verde and the Arroyo Cuervo area. The keyframe runs -5440 to 460 and the dossier keeps it on purpose (nothing else draws New Mexico and Colorado until the Ancestral Puebloans). It follows the infobox 'Geographical range: New Mexico, Colorado' like the other generous culture ranges of the period (Green Sahara, Aboriginal Australians), and an override would reach through every later window, so I left it.

Halaf loss of 43 cells (Kahramanmaras, Gaziantep, Osmaniye) at -5450 rests on Domuztepe being abandoned c. 5450 BC; a settlement's abandonment does not strictly mean the culture lost the land, but the dossier cites the page and the amount is 43 cells.

Gaps the dossiers record knowingly: Shandong is empty -5499..-5301 (Houli ended -5500, Beixin begins -5300); the western Mediterranean after Cardial Ware (-5500) has no dossier. Vinca culture begins -5400 and takes the Starcevo core, which falls in the next window (m5400-m5301), not this one.

Packet flags: no size-rule conflicts, no skipped events, no unresolved regions, no colony or hierarchy relations, no contests or occupations, no close-colour neighbour pairs. Largest changes (-5500: Kelteminar 1720, Linear Pottery 938, Houli end 868, Ubaid +642, Samarra +249; -5440 Oshara 1878) all match the dossier ledgers and the dates on their Wikipedia infoboxes as the dossiers quote them (Kelteminar 5500-3500, Linear Pottery c. 5500-c. 4500, Samarra 5500-4800, Ubaid south c. 5500-3800, Oshara 5440 BCE-460 CE).
